text:
mae: Heads-up — automated regression detector just pinned runtime 3.2.1 for model-group `fast-inference` in us-west pending investigation.

deploybot: action=pin applied runtime=runtime-3.2.1 scope=model-group:fast-inference regions:us-west reason:"latency spike > 2x" by:auto-detector

sanjay: saw that. telemetry confirms 95th latency up ~2.4x after deploy around 03:10 UTC.

lucy: any errors in kernels? I can roll a hotfix for kernel selector quickly.

mae: looks like quantized kernel fallback to generic path. suspect kernel-selector mismatch with SDK 2.9. Please confirm SDK versions in the pinned cohort.

phil: SDK in prod for that cohort is 2.9.1 — we had compatibility note in last release but thought it was safe.

ops-sre: SLO hit: latency breaches for customers A,B. We should open a rollback window if not mitigated in 30m.

lucy: propose staged unpin in us-west, then run canary unpin in eu-west later. Plan: run kernel quickpatch, redeploy kernel selector, then unpin.

sanjay: agree. If rollback needed, use `/deploybot rollback runtime runtime-3.2.1 --scope model-group:fast-inference --to runtime-3.1.4`

mae: @lucy please post the quickpatch PR link and I'll coordinate rollout with support.

lucy: PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/8421 — small change to kernel affinity. Includes test vector. Deploying to canary now.

deploybot: canary-deploy started job=deploy-8421-canary region=us-west-2

ops-sre: monitoring — adding alert mute for noisy errors for next 45m.

sanjay: if canary fixes latency, we'll schedule soft-unpin at +30m and full unpin after 2h.

mae: noted. Also document release note change: "compat: SDK 2.9.x requires kernel selector patch for runtime 3.2.1" — will add to release notes.

phil: tagging @support-team so they can inform impacted customers.

support-team: thanks — preparing customer comms template.

mae: update: canary latency back to baseline. Lucy please proceed with staged unpin when ready.

lucy: staging unpin in us-west: `/deploybot unpin runtime runtime-3.2.1 --scope model-group:fast-inference --regions us-west-*`

deploybot: unpin queue accepted job=unpin-8421-usw started

ops-sre: great. after full unpin, plan to add fallback routing to runtime-3.1 for 24h to absorb traffic.

mae: closing loop — will update release notes and create follow-up doc for compatibility checklist.

phil: :thumbsup:

support-team: comms sent to affected accounts.
